digest.component_or_area: Plan Review LLM Prompting and Caching
propositions: Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier prompts currently fail to share a plan-bearing cache prefix because the finder embeds the plan in its system prompt while the verifier routes it to the user message, preventing Anthropic's block-level cache deduplication.

Moving the plan into a shared prefix (preamble + plan heading + plan text) at the system prompt head of both the finder and verifier enables within-pass reuse across verifier chunks and best-effort cross-run reuse within Anthropic's 5-minute cache TTL.

Byte identity across passes must be enforced as a single-source structural invariant by moving `_SHARED_PREAMBLE` logic from passes.py to prompts.py (as `SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE` and `shared_plan_prefix()`) so no template can drift or duplicate the prefix.

The Pass-1 finder warm gate must measure the actual cached bytes (the shared prefix, not the plan alone) by switching from `est_tokens(plan)` to `est_tokens(shared_plan_prefix(plan))` via a new `_prefix_tokens()` helper to stay consistent with CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS floor.

An exhaustiveness directive ("enumerate EVERY independent defect in THIS run; do not defer deeper findings to a later round") must be added as a bullet to `SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE` to strengthen incremental-depth block-loop behavior.

The per-run finding listing must remain in the user message (as `instructions` from `base_instructions`) and be stripped from the verifier system prompt by removing the volatile marker entirely so the system prompt becomes the stable cache segment.
